integer i=0;
function integer generate(){
 i++;$out.0.case_id=i;
 string text=i%2==1 ? "2025-02-30" : "2025-1-1";
 $out.0.raw_date=text;$out.0.decimal_threw=false;$out.0.decimal_null=false;
 try {decimal d=str2decimal("");$out.0.decimal_null=isnull(d);} catch(CTLException e){$out.0.decimal_threw=true;}
 $out.0.is_date=isDate(text,"yyyy-MM-dd","en.US","UTC",true);
 $out.0.parse_threw=false;$out.0.parsed_date=null;
 try {date dt=str2date(text,"yyyy-MM-dd","en.US","UTC",true);$out.0.parsed_date=date2str(dt,"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss","en.US","UTC");}catch(CTLException e){$out.0.parse_threw=true;}
 $out.0.unicode_length=length("A😀");
 return OK;
}</attr>

function integer transform(){
$out.0.case_id=$in.0.case_id == null ? null : num2str($in.0.case_id);
$out.0.raw_date=$in.0.raw_date;
$out.0.decimal_threw=$in.0.decimal_threw == null ? null : ($in.0.decimal_threw ? "true" : "false");
$out.0.decimal_null=$in.0.decimal_null == null ? null : ($in.0.decimal_null ? "true" : "false");
$out.0.is_date=$in.0.is_date == null ? null : ($in.0.is_date ? "true" : "false");
$out.0.parse_threw=$in.0.parse_threw == null ? null : ($in.0.parse_threw ? "true" : "false");
$out.0.parsed_date=$in.0.parsed_date;
$out.0.unicode_length=$in.0.unicode_length == null ? null : num2str($in.0.unicode_length);
return OK;}</attr>
    </Node>
    <Node id="Writer0" type="DATA_WRITER" enabled="enabled" guiName="Writer0" guiX="950" guiY="200">

      <attr name="createEmptyFiles">true</attr>
